section_laws.name: SecBaseChangeSt
section_laws.scope_note: Exact retained original law. Locally Noetherian original scheme; n>=1; basis on a neighborhood; every arbitrary commutative affine target R. Uses actual Moduli.toPolAV at n=1. No flatness, reducedness or Noetherianity restriction on R.

source.declaration: Retained exact SecBaseChangeSt: locally Noetherian original base and arbitrary affine target

section_laws.exact_definition_text:
def SecBaseChangeSt : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{0}) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (P : PolAV S) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n →
    ∀ p : S, ∃ V : S.Opens, p ∈ V ∧ ∃ b : Fin (n ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (LPow P.A P.L n (overRes (T := baseOver S) V)),
      ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ (overRes (T := baseOver S) V).left)
        (b' : Fin (n ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (LPow P.A P.L n (baseAt t))),
        (∀ i, IsPullSec P.A P.L n (homAt t ▷ P.A) (whiskerRight_snd (homAt t) P.A) (b i) (b' i)) →
        LinearIndependent Γ((baseAt t).left, ⊤)
            (fun i => (SecM.ofSec P.A (b' i) : SecM P.A P.L n (baseAt t))) ∧
          Submodule.span Γ((baseAt t).left, ⊤)
            (Set.range fun i => (SecM.ofSec P.A (b' i) : SecM P.A P.L n (baseAt t))) = ⊤

section_laws.name: SecTwistSt
section_laws.scope_note: Exact retained original law for arbitrary original S/P, q>=1, all local coefficient rings, translated line, q^g basis and every residue-section lift. The proof only consumes its actual complex-fiber instances, but does not claim the global supplier.

source.declaration: Retained exact SecTwistSt: all local rings, twisted bases and residue-section lifts

section_laws.exact_definition_text:
def SecTwistSt : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{0}) (P : PolAV S) (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q →
    ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ S)
      (c : Over.mk t ⟶ P.A),
      (∃ b : Fin (q ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (twistLB P.A P.L q c), IsSecBasis _ b) ∧
      ∀ sbar : LB.Sec (LB.LinComb P.L (K := Fin 2)
          (fun k => ((Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R))) rfl :
            Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R)) ≫ t) ⟶ Over.mk t) ▷ P.A).left ≫
              ![(snd (Over.mk t) P.A).left, (translPt P.A c).left] k) ![(q : ℤ) - 1, 1]),
        ∃ s : LB.Sec (twistLB P.A P.L q c), IsPullSecLC P.L _ _ _ s sbar

ordinary_foundations.scope_note: Finite abelian primary decomposition; integer lattice index equals absolute determinant; finite projective determinants and trace-pairing nondegeneracy. The odd Gauss-sum sign and cyclic recurrence are proved explicitly in NFL1.

Real Gaussian integration, Poisson summation for Schwartz functions, holomorphic continuation, Cauchy derivative formula, Liouville and the identity theorem. Exact determinant and phase factors are derived in NFL2–NFL3. No theta transformation law is assumed.

Smooth finite-presentation algebraic charts, cotangent bases, regular-function holomorphy on complex charts, and local section evaluation. NFL13–NFL14 explain finite expressions for arbitrary R; no analytic structure on Spec R is postulated.
